fields.Participants: MSME Sales, Field Sales, Compliance, AR
fields.Volume: Target ~50,000 active MSME partners within 3 years

workflows.name: Sari-Sari Store & MSME Prospecting, Onboarding & KYC

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-register of "registers via app with store photo, location, owner ID" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates business legitimacy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "account in customer master with tier, credit terms, default reorder list" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-206 (ensure MSME micro-wholesale credit & order integrity.)
- operational: ID/permit validation and sanctions screening
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Fake/unverified MSME accounts enable fraud; mitigated by ID/permit validation and sanctions screening
System Touchpoints: - Mobile sign-up app; customer master; KYC workflow; sanctions screening

steps.activity: Field Sales prospects sari-sari stores, hardware mini-marts, small contractors in store catchment; registers via app with store photo, location, owner ID
Compliance performs KYC: DTI/SEC/Mayor's permit, owner valid ID, BIR TIN; validates business legitimacy; screens for sanctions/AML (W2921 linkage)
AR creates MSME account in customer master with tier, credit terms, default reorder list; activates in loyalty-as-reseller program

workflows.name: "BuildRight Negosyo Partner" Tier, Pricing & Benefits Configuration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Pricing configures tier-based wholesale discount" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews tier qualification quarterly based on purchase volume" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-475 (ensure controlled execution — MSME/Sari-Sari Account Acquisition & Micro-Distribution (PA-82.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin risk**: Over-discounting erodes wholesale margin; mitigated by tier economics modeling
System Touchpoints: - Customer price matrix; tier master; loyalty engine; benefits catalog
Time Estimate: - 1–2 weeks per tier setup; quarterly review

steps.activity: Pricing configures tier-based wholesale discount (3%–12% off SRP), volume rebates, and exclusive "Negosyo" SKU pricing in ERP customer price matrix
Marketing sets tier benefits: free delivery threshold, priority allocation, Negosyo Academy access, loyalty points multiplier, financing access
MSME Sales reviews tier qualification quarterly based on purchase volume; upgrades/downgrades accounts; communicates changes

fields.Trigger: Quarterly assortment review; new MSME segment

workflows.name: Micro-Reseller Right-Sized Assortment & Reorder List Curation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "reviews sell-through by MSME segment" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-475 (ensure controlled execution — MSME/Sari-Sari Account Acquisition & Micro-Distribution (PA-82.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Relevance risk**: Wrong assortment reduces MSME stickiness; mitigated by segment-level sell-through analysis
System Touchpoints: - Assortment master; reorder list templates; sell-through analytics

steps.activity: Category Manager curates right-sized assortment for sari-sari resale: fast-moving hardware, basic electrical/plumbing, paints, adhesives, fasteners in small pack sizes
Merchandising configures default reorder lists per MSME segment (sari-sari vs. mini-mart vs. contractor); sets suggested order quantities
MSME Sales reviews sell-through by MSME segment; recommends assortment additions/deletions based on demand patterns

fields.Participants: Training Mgr, Category Manager, MSME Sales, Marketing
fields.Trigger: Quarterly content calendar; new product launch

workflows.name: MSME Product Knowledge, Negosyo Academy & Retailer Training

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measures participation, knowledge uplift, and correlation with purchase growth" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-475 (ensure controlled execution — MSME/Sari-Sari Account Acquisition & Micro-Distribution (PA-82.1).)
- operational: multilingual micro-content and in-store support
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adoption risk**: Low MSME digital literacy limits reach; mitigated by multilingual micro-content and in-store support
System Touchpoints: - Mobile learning app; LMS; engagement analytics

steps.activity: Training develops "Negosyo Academy" curriculum: basic business skills, inventory management, merchandising, product knowledge, digital payments adoption
Marketing delivers via mobile app (micro-learning, video), SMS tips, and in-store workshops; gamifies completion with rewards
MSME Sales measures participation, knowledge uplift, and correlation with purchase growth; refines curriculum

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors competitor wholesale/retail pricing in MSME-resale categories" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates MSME margin allows resale at competitive sari-sari shelf price" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks micro-wholesale gross margin and volume growth" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-206 (ensure MSME micro-wholesale credit & order integrity.)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin risk**: Aggressive wholesale pricing erodes segment profitability; mitigated by monthly margin tracking
System Touchpoints: - Pricing analytics; competitor intelligence (VS-57); margin dashboard

steps.activity: Pricing Analyst monitors competitor wholesale/retail pricing in MSME-resale categories (cement, paint, fasteners); benchmarks BuildRight wholesale price
Category Manager validates MSME margin allows resale at competitive sari-sari shelf price; adjusts tier discount to maintain MSME attractiveness
Finance tracks micro-wholesale gross margin and volume growth; validates segment profitability vs. acquisition cost

fields.Trigger: MSME cluster forms or co-op agreement

workflows.name: MSME Co-op & "Aling Mary" Cluster Group Buying Aggregation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates co-op legitimacy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks cluster economics vs." (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-206 (ensure MSME micro-wholesale credit & order integrity.)
- operational: clear governance and split invoicing
Pain Points / Risks: - **Operational risk**: Cluster dissolution complicates orders; mitigated by clear governance and split invoicing
System Touchpoints: - Cluster ordering module; multi-drop delivery routing; cluster analytics

steps.activity: MSME Sales organizes small MSMEs into buying clusters (5–20 stores) to reach volume thresholds for higher tier pricing and consolidated delivery
Operations configures cluster ordering in ERP (single PO, multi-drop delivery, split invoicing); validates co-op legitimacy
Finance tracks cluster economics vs. individual MSME; reports cluster program growth and margin impact

workflows.name: Field Sales / Promodizer Route Management & Micro-Account Coverage

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "accounts based on coverage and growth potential" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-route of "Field Sales visits micro-accounts per route cadence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks field rep productivity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-475 (ensure controlled execution — MSME/Sari-Sari Account Acquisition & Micro-Distribution (PA-82.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Productivity risk**: Inefficient routes raise cost-per-account; mitigated by density-based planning
System Touchpoints: - Route planning; mobile order app; field-rep productivity dashboard

steps.activity: MSME Sales plans field rep routes by MSME density geography; assigns accounts based on coverage and growth potential
Field Sales visits micro-accounts per route cadence; takes orders via mobile, captures store conditions, collects feedback, educates on promos
HR/MSME Sales tracks field rep productivity (visits, orders, new accounts); optimizes territory and incentive structure

workflows.name: MSME Account Health, Churn Prevention & Win-Back

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "account health score" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow notification of "contacts at-risk MSME" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports churn rate and win-back conversion" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-475 (ensure controlled execution — MSME/Sari-Sari Account Acquisition & Micro-Distribution (PA-82.1).)
- operational: health-score monitoring and proactive outreach
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retention risk**: Silent churn erodes segment base; mitigated by health-score monitoring and proactive outreach
System Touchpoints: - Account-health scorecard; CRM intervention workflow; churn analytics

steps.activity: Loyalty/MSME Sales monitors account health score (recency, frequency, basket trend); flags at-risk accounts for intervention
Field Sales contacts at-risk MSME; diagnoses reason (price, competition, stockout, closure); offers targeted win-back incentive
MSME Sales reports churn rate and win-back conversion; refines retention playbook and incentive design
